questions.q: Choose the sentence about a daily routine.
options: She is usually walk to work.
questions.explanation: Third-person singular present simple takes -s: walks.

questions.q: “I ___ in Namangan, but my sister lives in Tashkent.”
questions.explanation: I live: present simple with I.

questions.q: “We ___ the same English teacher.”
questions.explanation: We have: plural subject.

questions.q: “There ___ two notebooks on the desk.”
questions.explanation: There are: plural noun notebooks.

questions.q: “He ___ breakfast before school every day.”
questions.explanation: He has breakfast: regular habit.

questions.q: Choose the opposite of “early”.
questions.explanation: Early and late contrast in time.

questions.q: “The glass is empty.” What is the opposite of “empty”?
questions.explanation: Full is the antonym of empty.

questions.q: Which word completes “a ___ of shoes”?
questions.explanation: A pair of shoes is the conventional expression.

questions.q: “I am thirsty.” What do I need?
questions.explanation: Thirsty describes the need for a drink.

questions.q: Which phrase means “not expensive”?
questions.explanation: Low-priced describes cost, not sales or condition.

questions.q: When does Ali finish work?
questions.explanation: The passage states that he goes home at five.
questions.passage: Ali works in a library. He arrives at eight forty-five, begins work at nine and goes home at five. His brother finishes at six.

questions.q: What does Sara eat for breakfast?
questions.explanation: Sara has bread and milk.
questions.passage: Sara gets up at seven. She buys eggs for tomorrow but today she eats bread and drinks milk before walking to school.

questions.q: How does Tom usually travel to work?
questions.explanation: Tom usually cycles to work.
questions.passage: Tom owns a car and sometimes takes the bus, but he usually rides his bicycle to the office because it is nearby.

questions.q: When can you visit the shop?
questions.explanation: Friday at five falls during the stated opening hours.
questions.passage: The shop opens from eight in the morning to six in the evening, Monday to Saturday. It is closed all day Sunday.

questions.q: How many pets does Mina have altogether?
questions.explanation: Two cats plus one dog equals three pets.
questions.passage: Mina has two cats, one white and one black, and a small brown dog. Her neighbour has a rabbit.

questions.q: What time will the train actually leave?
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
questions.audio: Good morning. The train at seven forty-five has been cancelled. The next one leaves at eight fifteen. Please be on the platform by eight five.

questions.q: Which drink does the customer order?
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
questions.audio: Could I have tea, please? No, not coffee. Tea is fine, and please don’t put sugar in it.

questions.q: Where is the speaker going first?
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
questions.audio: I’m going to the supermarket for bread. After that, I’ll walk through the park on my way home.

questions.q: How many museum tickets are needed?
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
questions.audio: Two tickets, please. My sister is coming with me, but our parents have their tickets already.

questions.q: What colour is the speaker’s own bag?
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
questions.audio: There’s a black bag by the window, but it isn’t mine. My bag is blue, on the chair.

questions.q: At a café, you are ready to order. Which request is most appropriate?
options: Could I have a tea, please?
Do I get you a tea?
I should give you a tea.
questions.explanation: Could I have …, please? is a natural polite request.

questions.q: Someone says “Sorry I am late.” Choose a suitable reply.
questions.explanation: No problem responds naturally to a minor apology.

questions.q: You want to ask the time. Which question is correct?
questions.explanation: Direct question requires is before it.

questions.q: You cannot hear your teacher. What should you say?
options: Could you say that again, please?
questions.explanation: Polite repetition request: Could you say that again?

questions.q: You meet a new classmate. Which response fits after “My name is Sam”?
questions.explanation: Nice to meet you is a standard greeting.

questions.q: “We ___ the exhibition last Saturday.”
questions.explanation: Finished, dated past event: visited.

questions.q: “There isn’t ___ information on the poster.”
questions.explanation: Information is uncountable: much.

questions.q: “If the shop is closed, we ___ online.”
questions.explanation: First conditional: if + present, will + base verb.

questions.q: “The new route is ___ than the old one.”
questions.explanation: Comparative form: faster than.

questions.q: “I have been at this school ___ September.”
questions.explanation: Since introduces the starting time.

questions.q: Which document shows you have already paid?
questions.explanation: A receipt confirms payment; an invoice requests payment.

questions.q: The platform was “crowded” at noon. What does this mean?
questions.explanation: Crowded: many people in one place.

questions.q: Which verb means to fix a broken device?
questions.explanation: Repair means fix; replace means use a different device.

questions.q: You “borrow” a laptop when you …
questions.explanation: Borrow implies temporary use, usually with permission.

questions.q: Choose the natural English expression.
questions.explanation: Take a photo is standard English.

questions.q: Why did Anna miss the bus?
options: She went to the wrong stop.
questions.explanation: Uning budilnigi ishlamagan.
questions.passage: Anna arrived late because her alarm did not ring. She missed the 8:10 bus and took the next one at 8:40.

questions.q: What is included in the museum ticket?
questions.explanation: Ticket includes a guided tour.
questions.passage: Entry to the museum costs ten pounds. The price includes a short guided tour, but food and drinks are extra.

questions.q: When should the form be sent?
questions.explanation: “by Thursday evening” — juma kunidan oldin.
questions.passage: Please complete the application by Thursday evening. We will contact successful applicants on Monday.

questions.q: Why is the meeting online?
questions.explanation: Ofis ta’mirlanayotgani uchun online.
questions.passage: We will meet online this week because the office is being repaired. The usual room will be available next Monday.

questions.q: What should guests bring?
questions.explanation: Tashqaridagi tadbir uchun warm clothes so‘ralgan.
questions.passage: The evening event is outside. Chairs and drinks are provided, but please bring warm clothes because it may get cold.

questions.q: When will the class start?
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
questions.audio: We usually begin at ten, but our teacher’s train is delayed. Today we will start half an hour later, at ten thirty.

questions.q: Where must visitors go before Room 12?
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
questions.audio: Please don’t go straight to room twelve. Pick up your visitor card at reception first, then head upstairs.

questions.q: Which appointment does the caller request?
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
questions.audio: I’m booked for Tuesday morning. I have a meeting then. Could I move the appointment to Thursday afternoon?

questions.q: What is the price for a student?
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
questions.audio: Adult tickets are twelve pounds. With a student card, it’s eight. Children pay six pounds.

questions.q: What did the speaker eventually buy?
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
questions.audio: I went out for a jacket, and almost bought a coat instead, but I ended up getting shoes.

questions.q: You need to reschedule a lesson. Which message is best?
options: Could we move tomorrow’s lesson to Friday?
My lesson can be moving after.
Tomorrow we are not previous lesson.
questions.explanation: Could we move …? is clear and polite.

questions.q: Your friend offers another slice of cake but you have eaten enough.
questions.explanation: No thanks, I’m full is a natural polite refusal.

questions.q: A sign reads “Staff only”. What should visitors do?
options: Wait for a staff member to invite them.
Go inside to ask for information.
Enter if the door is open.
Use the area when it is quiet.
questions.explanation: Staff only restricts access to authorised staff.

questions.q: Which request is both polite and grammatically correct?
options: Could you tell me where the station is?
Could you tell me where is the station?
Can you say where does the station stand?
Would you tell where the station is it?
questions.explanation: Embedded questions use statement word order.

questions.q: Complete naturally: “I’m looking forward ___ from you.”
questions.explanation: Look forward to + -ing form.

questions.q: I wish I ___ more time to study.
questions.explanation: Hozirgi vaziyatga nisbatan wish + Past Simple.

questions.q: The report ___ before the meeting.
questions.explanation: Passive Past Simple: was finished.

questions.q: She asked me where I ___.
questions.explanation: Reported question: she asked where I lived.

questions.q: You ___ wear a seat belt in a car.
questions.explanation: Must — qat’iy majburiyat.

questions.q: By the time I arrived, they ___ dinner.
questions.explanation: Oldin tugagan harakat: Past Perfect.

questions.q: Which word best describes someone whose promises you can depend on?
questions.explanation: Reliable refers to dependable behaviour; consistent means stable.

questions.q: Which expression most directly means selecting one of several options?
questions.explanation: Make a decision means to choose an option; the other expressions describe agreement, risk or inference.

questions.q: A deadline is the time by which a task …
questions.explanation: A deadline is the latest permitted completion time.

questions.q: “Reduce” is closest to ___.
questions.explanation: Reduce — kamaytirmoq.

questions.q: “Put off” a meeting means to ___.
questions.explanation: Put off — keyinga qoldirmoq.

questions.q: What is the writer’s main concern?
questions.explanation: Asosiy shikoyat — kechki transport cheklangan.
questions.passage: Public transport has improved during the day, but people who work late still struggle to get home. The last bus leaves before many evening shifts finish.

questions.q: Why did the company change its policy?
questions.explanation: Xodimlar so‘rovlariga javoban o‘zgartirilgan.
questions.passage: After a staff survey showed demand for flexibility, the company introduced two remote-working days each week. Managers will review the arrangement after three months.

questions.q: What does “this approach” refer to?
questions.explanation: This approach — kichik loyihalar orqali o‘qitish.
questions.passage: Rather than memorising long lists of rules, students now complete short projects. Teachers believe this approach helps them use knowledge in realistic situations.

questions.q: Which statement is supported?
options: The new facilities are already open.
The park will add lighting next spring.
questions.explanation: Yangi yoritish bahorda o‘rnatilishi aytilgan.
questions.passage: The council has approved plans to install lighting in the city park next spring. The playground will remain open during the work, although some paths may close temporarily.

questions.q: What can be inferred about the workshop?
options: It is meant only for experts.
questions.explanation: “No previous experience is required” — yangi boshlovchilar ham qatnashadi.
questions.passage: This Saturday’s photography workshop is designed for curious beginners. Cameras can be borrowed, and no previous experience is required. Places are limited.

questions.q: Why did the workshop finish early?
options: A technical issue interrupted the session
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
questions.audio: We planned to continue until five. Attendance was good and the speaker felt fine, but the sound system stopped working, so we finished early.

questions.q: What is the woman’s main concern about the new timetable?
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
questions.audio: The revised timetable works for most people, but I’m worried it leaves those with part-time jobs little room to move classes around.

questions.q: What does the man decide to do?
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
questions.audio: I’d prefer not to cancel. Could you switch my booking from Friday to the following Monday?

questions.q: Why does the tutor recommend the article?
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
questions.audio: The article is quite long, but its main advantage is that it compares two approaches side by side.

questions.q: What has improved since the last meeting?
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
questions.audio: Funding hasn’t increased, and the team is the same size, but we now answer requests much faster.

questions.q: You disagree politely in a team meeting. Choose the best response.
options: I understand your point, but could we consider another option?
That is not right, and everybody knows it.
You should have thought before speaking.
questions.explanation: Acknowledging another view before a proposal keeps the tone professional.

questions.q: A colleague asks whether the report is ready. It is almost complete.
options: I’m just putting the finishing touches on it.
It was just being finished tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Putting the finishing touches on something = completing the last details.

questions.q: Complete: “I’ll let you know as soon as I ___ an answer.”
questions.explanation: After as soon as referring to the future, use present simple.

questions.q: Which opening fits a formal email requesting information?
options: I am writing to enquire about the course.
You have to explain the course.
questions.explanation: A neutral, clear request suits a formal email.

questions.q: Choose the most natural phrase: “We had to ___ the meeting until Monday.”
questions.explanation: Put off means postpone.

questions.q: Hardly ___ the presentation begun when the alarm rang.
questions.explanation: Hardly had + subject + past participle — inversiya.

questions.q: If she had left earlier, she ___ the train.
questions.explanation: Third conditional: would have + V3.

questions.q: The proposal, ___ was submitted last week, has been approved.
questions.explanation: Non-defining relative clause bilan which.

questions.q: Not only ___ the plan succeed, but it also saved money.
questions.explanation: Not only gap boshida bo‘lsa did + subject + verb inversiyasi.

questions.q: She ___ forgotten the appointment; she is always punctual.
questions.explanation: Can’t have + V3 — o‘tgan holat haqida kuchli inkor xulosasi.

questions.q: “Mitigate” a risk means to ___.
questions.explanation: Mitigate — salbiy ta’sirini kamaytirish.

questions.q: Which collocation is most natural?
questions.explanation: Deep concern about — to‘g‘ri collocation.

questions.q: A “feasible” proposal is ___.
questions.explanation: Feasible — amalga oshirish mumkin.

questions.q: “Scrutinise” means ___.
questions.explanation: Scrutinise — sinchiklab tekshirmoq.

questions.q: Choose the correct phrase.
questions.explanation: Reach a compromise — murosaga kelmoq.

questions.q: What is the writer’s attitude toward remote work?
questions.explanation: Yordam beradi, biroq cheklovlar mavjud.
questions.passage: Remote work can make employment accessible to more people, particularly those with lengthy commutes. Yet managers should not assume it suits every task: mentoring and collaborative design sometimes benefit from being together.

questions.q: What is the main implication?
options: The pilot proved the system useless.
questions.explanation: Bir shahardagi muvaffaqiyatni hamma joyga tatbiq qilib bo‘lmaydi.
questions.passage: A pilot programme reduced waste by 18% in one city. However, the organisers warned that local recycling facilities differ considerably, so the outcome should not be extrapolated without further trials.

questions.q: What does “offset” mean in this context?
questions.explanation: Offset — salbiy xarajatni qoplash yoki kamaytirish.
questions.passage: The new equipment requires a substantial initial investment, but lower energy bills should offset these costs over several years.

questions.q: Which assumption is the writer challenging?
options: More data always creates better decisions.
questions.explanation: Muallif faqat ma’lumot ko‘payishi yetarli emasligini aytadi.
questions.passage: Organisations often collect more and more data, assuming that quantity produces better decisions. In reality, unclear objectives and weak analysis can make extensive data sets surprisingly unhelpful.

questions.q: Why were the findings unexpected?
options: A small group showed a stronger effect.
questions.explanation: Kichik guruhda kattaroq o‘zgarish kuzatilgan.
questions.passage: Researchers expected the intervention to benefit larger classes most. Instead, the strongest improvement appeared in groups of fewer than twelve learners, prompting a closer examination of teacher feedback.

questions.q: What is the speaker’s main reservation?
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
questions.audio: The aims are sensible and the funding is secured. My concern is how much we expect to achieve before December.

questions.q: Which change was made to the research design?
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
questions.audio: We kept the same sample and control group but added interviews three months later to see whether the effects lasted.

questions.q: Why does the speaker favour the second proposal?
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
questions.audio: The first proposal would give visible results quickly, but the second tackles why the problem keeps returning.

questions.q: What can be inferred about the feedback?
options: It did not address the project
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
questions.audio: Several people praised the new format, while others found it confusing. We’ve used both sets of comments to revise it.

questions.q: What does the man imply about the deadline?
options: A short extension may be possible
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
questions.audio: The date is officially Friday, though if there’s a genuine problem we might be able to allow another day or two.

questions.q: Which sentence expresses a cautious inference?
options: He might have misunderstood the instructions.
He had to misunderstand the instructions.
He must not misunderstood the instructions.
He will have misunderstand the instructions.
questions.explanation: Might have + past participle expresses uncertain past inference.

questions.q: Choose the strongest but fair concession.
options: Although the cost is high, the long-term benefits may justify it.
The cost is high, so any benefit is impossible.
The cost is high, and every benefit is certain.
The cost is high because it is high.
questions.explanation: Concession acknowledges cost while preserving measured claim.

questions.q: Which link expresses an unexpected contrast?
questions.explanation: Nevertheless indicates that a result holds despite the preceding argument.

questions.q: Complete: “The proposal was rejected ___ insufficient evidence.”
questions.explanation: Due to + noun phrase is idiomatic.

questions.q: Which is the most natural academic phrasing?
questions.explanation: Conduct research into is an established academic collocation.

questions.q: Rarely ___ such a nuanced analysis in a public debate.
questions.explanation: Rarely boshida inversiya: do we encounter.

questions.q: Had the findings been replicated, the claim ___ stronger.
questions.explanation: Formal inverted third conditional: would have been.

questions.q: The committee insisted that the report ___ published in full.
questions.explanation: Mandative subjunctive: insist that + base form.

questions.q: It was not until the trial ended ___ the anomaly became apparent.
questions.explanation: Cleft construction: not until ... that.

questions.q: She spoke as though she ___ the decision herself.
questions.explanation: Unreal past reference: as though + Past Perfect.

questions.q: “Equivocal” evidence is ___.
questions.explanation: Equivocal — bir ma’noli bo‘lmagan.

questions.q: “Inadvertently” most nearly means ___.
questions.explanation: Inadvertently — bilmasdan, tasodifan.

questions.q: A “salient” feature is ___.
questions.explanation: Salient — eng muhim yoki ko‘zga tashlanadigan.

questions.q: “Exacerbate” a problem means to ___.
questions.explanation: Exacerbate — muammoni kuchaytirmoq.

questions.q: Which collocation is standard?
questions.explanation: Bear the consequences — oqibatlarga duch kelmoq.

questions.q: What rhetorical strategy does the author use?
questions.explanation: Avval afzallikni tan oladi, keyin cheklovni ko‘rsatadi.
questions.passage: The intervention undeniably improved short-term engagement. Nevertheless, treating engagement as a proxy for sustained learning risks overlooking whether participants retain and transfer the knowledge months later.

questions.q: Which inference is best supported?
options: The analysis may mask internal differences.
questions.explanation: O‘rtacha ko‘rsatkich subguruhlar farqini yashirishi mumkin.
questions.passage: Although the aggregate figures suggest modest gains, separating participants by prior experience reveals two sharply contrasting trajectories. The overall average therefore tells only part of the story.

questions.q: What does “contingent” mean here?
questions.explanation: Contingent on — shartlarga bog‘liq.
questions.passage: The success of the initiative is contingent on sustained funding and the cooperation of regional agencies, neither of which has yet been secured.

questions.q: What is the author criticising?
questions.explanation: Bir sababga haddan ziyod katta rol berilishi tanqid qilinadi.
questions.passage: Attributing the decline entirely to digital media is appealingly simple, but it ignores economic pressures, changes in curriculum and the possibility that several factors interact.

questions.q: What does the final sentence suggest?
options: The team adapted its strategy in response to limitations.
questions.explanation: Cheklovlar tan olinib, yondashuv o‘zgartirilgan.
questions.passage: The original framework assumed that all communities had access to similar infrastructure. Once this assumption proved untenable, the researchers redesigned the intervention rather than forcing local conditions into a uniform model.

questions.q: What qualification does the speaker make?
options: The reform may work only in some contexts
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
questions.audio: I support the reform in principle, but outcomes will depend on local capacity. It would be a mistake to expect the same results everywhere.

questions.q: Why is the follow-up study mentioned?
options: It replicated the original effect exactly
It found a smaller effect, challenging the first estimate
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
questions.audio: The first study found a large improvement. The bigger follow-up, however, detected a smaller effect and wider uncertainty.

questions.q: What attitude is conveyed?
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
questions.audio: This is encouraging, but I would not call it a breakthrough until an independent team can reproduce the findings.

questions.q: What is implied about the public summary?
options: It is more detailed than the appendix
It omits an important methodological caveat
It reports exactly the same uncertainty
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
questions.audio: The technical appendix shows overlapping confidence intervals. That detail, rather conveniently, is absent from the executive summary.

questions.q: Why does the speaker withhold judgement?
options: The study lacks sufficient follow-up evidence
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
questions.audio: The early signals look promising, yet the observation window is short. I’d prefer to see longer-term data before taking a firm position.

questions.q: Which claim is most carefully qualified?
options: The policy is guaranteed to improve outcomes.
The findings suggest an association, although causation remains unproven.
The policy works in every situation.
The evidence has eliminated all uncertainty.
questions.explanation: Suggest and remains unproven express academically appropriate caution.

questions.q: Choose the transition that signals a consequence of the policy change.
questions.explanation: Consequently signals a result, not contrast or illustration.

questions.q: Which phrase introduces a measured objection?
options: There are compelling reasons to question the representativeness of the sample.
The sample is obviously worthless to everyone.
It is impossible to believe any numbers.
Only fools would accept this evidence.
questions.explanation: Measured criticism identifies the specific weakness.

questions.q: Complete: “The author draws a distinction ___ correlation and causation.”
questions.explanation: Draw a distinction between two concepts.

questions.q: Complete: “The findings must be interpreted ___ the small sample size.”
questions.explanation: In light of introduces a relevant consideration.

questions.q: No sooner ___ the announcement been made than speculation intensified.
questions.explanation: No sooner had + subject + V3 than...

questions.q: Were it not for the preliminary data, the hypothesis ___ untenable.
questions.explanation: Were it not for — formal unreal conditional.

questions.q: He demanded that the allegation ___ independently verified.
questions.explanation: Subjunctive passive: be verified.

questions.q: Such ___ the intensity of the debate that proceedings were suspended.
questions.explanation: Such was the intensity ... that — formal inversion.

questions.q: The report is all the more compelling ___ its limitations are candidly acknowledged.
questions.explanation: Because qo‘shimcha asos keltiradi; all the more compelling because...

questions.q: “Perspicacious” most nearly means ___.
questions.explanation: Perspicacious — teran fahmli.

questions.q: “Obfuscate” an argument means to ___.
questions.explanation: Obfuscate — ma’noni xiralashtirmoq.

questions.q: A “pyrrhic victory” is ___.
options: a win gained at excessive cost
questions.explanation: Pyrrhic victory — juda katta evaziga erishilgan g‘alaba.

questions.q: “Inchoate” refers to something ___.
questions.explanation: Inchoate — hali to‘liq shakllanmagan.

questions.q: To “prevaricate” is to ___.
options: evade the truth or speak evasively
questions.explanation: Prevaricate — haqiqatdan qochib, mujmal gapirmoq.

questions.q: Which underlying critique is implied?
options: A measurement framework can distort the phenomenon it purports to capture.
questions.explanation: O‘lchov tizimi o‘zi baholayotgan hodisani o‘zgartirib yuborishi mumkin.
questions.passage: Once departments were ranked by the volume of completed cases, staff began prioritising quick resolutions. The reported efficiency gains were real in a narrow sense, but the more complex cases accumulated out of view.

questions.q: What is the author’s central paradox?
options: Safeguards designed to improve fairness may introduce new inequities.
questions.explanation: Adolatni oshirish uchun qilingan choralar yangi tengsizlik yaratishi mumkin.
questions.passage: The revised admissions rules sought to eliminate subjective judgement. Yet by assigning rigid scores to extracurricular activities, they inadvertently advantaged applicants who could afford extensive private coaching.

questions.q: What does the tone most strongly suggest?
questions.explanation: “Impressive, if one disregards...” — kinoyali cheklov.
questions.passage: The proposal is impressively comprehensive—provided one disregards the minor inconvenience that it offers no plausible account of how its central commitments might be funded.

questions.q: What assumption is being exposed?
questions.explanation: Muallif korrelyatsiyadan sababiyat chiqarishni savol ostiga qo‘yadi.
questions.passage: A correlation between screen time and lower scores was presented as evidence of harm. Yet the analysis did not examine whether existing academic difficulties might themselves lead students to spend more time online.

questions.q: What is most strongly implied about the consensus?
options: It emerged from exhaustive independent debate.
It is supported by every dataset.
It may reflect institutional pressures rather than genuine agreement.
questions.explanation: Konsensus tashkiliy bosim natijasi bo‘lishi ehtimoli bor.
questions.passage: The report describes an unprecedented consensus, although dissenting reviewers were excluded from the final committee and several participating organisations had contractual reasons to endorse the outcome.

questions.q: What rhetorical strategy does the speaker use?
options: Concede the aim but question a hidden premise
questions.explanation: Audio yozuvdagi asosiy ma’lumot, taqqoslash yoki tuzatish javobni aniqlaydi.
